tab.title: Android App Update: New More & News Tabs
tab.summary: Settings, UX Wallet, Uxaoro Premium, Sales, and Badges are now organized inside the dedicated More tab on Android.
tab.markdown:
### New Navigation on Android

We have streamlined the Android navigation bar with two new tabs:

- **News**: Read platform announcements, release notes, and interactive HTML pages configured from `https://fourtexec.site/uxaoro/news/`.
- **More**: Access **Settings**, **UX Wallet**, **Uxaoro Premium**, **Sales**, and **Badges** in one convenient place.

tab.title: Uxaoro on Desktop & Web
tab.summary: Keyboard shortcuts, E2EE key backup, and multi-device sync tips for Desktop and Web users.
tab.markdown:
### Desktop & Web Tips

- **Shortcuts**: Use `Ctrl+1..5` (or `⌘+1..5` on macOS) to switch sections quickly, and `Ctrl+K` for search.
- **E2EE Key Backup**: Export your private key in **Settings** to read encrypted messages across all your devices.
